name: Elder Graveborn
summary: Near Brill, Elder Graveborn greets travelers during the Lunar Festival. The ancestral spirit honors them and points pilgrims toward other elders in northern Lordaeron.

sections.title: A Spirit in Tirisfal
sections.body: Elder Graveborn greets travelers just southeast of Brill during the Lunar Festival. The spectral elder stands among the haunted woods of Tirisfal Glades, where the Forsaken town lies nearby. Though the kingdom is troubled, Graveborn offers pilgrims peaceful greetings and ancestral wisdom. He also points them toward spirits in the Undercity, the Sepulcher, and across the Plaguelands.

faq.answer: Elder Graveborn is an ancestral ghost who appears during the Lunar Festival. In Tirisfal Glades, just southeast of Brill, he offers festival blessings to travelers.

faq.q: Why is he in Tirisfal Glades?
faq.answer: During the Lunar Festival, ancestral spirits gather across Azeroth to honor past heroes and shared heritage. Elder Graveborn watches over the land outside Brill.

faq.q: Can Alliance adventurers speak to him?
faq.answer: Yes. Festival elders welcome travelers of either faction. Alliance travelers should approach with care: Graveborn stands close to the Forsaken town of Brill.

faq.q: What information does he offer travelers?
faq.answer: Elder Graveborn points pilgrims toward other local spirits. He names the Undercity, the Sepulcher in Silverpine, Light's Hope Chapel, the Weeping Cave, and Scholomance.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you can find Graveborn on the road between Brill and the Undercity. His presence recalls Azeroth's ancient past, untouched by the Scourge or the blight.
As an Alliance pilgrim, you must skirt Brill to reach Graveborn without drawing the attention of Forsaken guards and patrols.
